ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of urban development in the Wuhan region, marked with “Wuhan”, and river lines can be seen passing near Wuhan; cities are distributed along the river in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River and in river confluence areas. Then reason: Wuhan is located in the Jianghan Plain and the plain area of the middle reaches of the Yangtze River. Plain areas have relatively low elevation and small ground relief; when floods arrive, water flow is not easy to drain out quickly, so the relationship between the frequent occurrence of flood disasters and its topographic characteristics is that the terrain is low and flat.

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有1982年和2005年两幅武汉地区城市发展图，范围约在30°—31°N、114°—116°E附近；武汉及周边不同等级城市多沿弯曲河流、水系附近分布，图中没有显示山地、高原等明显起伏地貌。再推理：武汉位于长江中游河流沿岸地区，若地形低洼平坦，降水或上游来水增多时水位上涨，地表径流排泄慢，容易积水受淹，因此洪涝灾害多发与地势低平有关。
method.model_answer: 地势低平，低洼平坦，容易积水受淹。
